_note: Atlas Intake VALIDATION set (Brain, 2026-10-30, AI-generated): 5 messages per reason. Used to tune thresholds / top-k and to choose the model. Not the Atlas examples, not the test set.

messages.text: Could you confirm my reservation at the resort for next month?
What gate does my flight leave from and at what time?
I can't remember how many nights I booked, can you check?
Is my booking with breakfast or without?
Please check that my flight booking went through.
The screen says my flight is delayed by two hours, what happens now?
We are still sitting on the plane, it hasn't moved for ninety minutes.
My connection was late and the whole trip is a mess.
How late is my flight to Miami going to be today?
Nobody at the airport can tell us when we will leave.
I won't be able to go anymore, please cancel my stay.
How do I cancel the hotel I booked for December?
Please cancel my reservation at the city hotel.
Can I cancel my room booking without losing money?
I have to call off my holiday, cancel everything please.
They cancelled my flight, I want the ticket money back.
I was charged for a hotel I cancelled weeks ago, refund me.
Please return my deposit, I cancelled in time.
My room was not the one I paid for, I want part of the price back.
The flight was so late I gave up on the trip, I'd like my money returned.
What am I owed for a flight that landed four hours late?
I want to claim the money airlines must pay for cancellations.
Am I entitled to anything because my flight was cancelled this morning?
Please process my compensation claim for the delay last week.
The rules say long delays are compensated, I'd like mine.
Put me on any flight that leaves tonight please.
Can I move my hotel stay to the following weekend?
I need a different flight, the new time doesn't work for me.
Is it possible to fly one day earlier instead?
Book me on the next available plane to Chicago.
My grandmother can't walk long distances, can she have a wheelchair at the gate?
I am deaf, how will I hear the boarding announcements?
Can you arrange help for a passenger who uses a walker?
I'm travelling with an autism assistance dog.
I need someone to help me board, I had surgery on my leg.
Is it hot in the Algarve in November?
Do you offer car rental too?
I forgot the password to my account.
Can you suggest things to do in Lisbon?
Good morning, I just want to say thanks.
